title: Express Dedekind psi as a product of prime-power chart counts
statement: For every nonzero natural number N, let S=N.primeFactors be its finite set of prime divisors and e_p=N.factorization p. With ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N defined as ∑_{d∣N, Squarefree d} N/d, one has ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N=∏_{p∈S}(p^e_p+p^(e_p−1)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N = N.primeFactors.prod (fun p => p ^ N.factorization p + p ^ (N.factorization p - 1))
